description: Restate in your own words what you think the user's goals are and what problem they're trying to solve. Use for /in-your-own-words.

compare.without: Echoes your wording, so you can't tell if it understood.
compare.with: Restates your goals in its own words.

compare.without: Repeats the task and skips what's blocking you.
compare.with: Names the problem you're trying to solve, on its own.

compare.without: Treats its reading of your request as settled.
compare.with: Lays out what it thinks you want, for you to see.

brief.intro: It has the AI restate, in its own words, what it thinks your goals are and what problem you're solving.

lessons.title: Ask for its own words
lessons.does: The AI doesn't echo your wording; it retells it as it understands it, so a misunderstanding shows at once.
lessons.why: An echo hides whether it understood; its own words expose any gap.
lessons.try: After you give a task, ask first: "Before you start, tell me in your own words what you plan to change."

lessons.quote: what you think the user's goals are
lessons.quoteTr: what you think the user's goals are
lessons.title: Ask for its guess
lessons.does: It lays out its understanding for you to correct, instead of treating it as fact and starting work.
lessons.why: "What you think" turns understanding into a guess that can be overturned, easy for it to say and for you to fix.
lessons.try: Frame it as a guess: "Tell me what you think I care about most, speed or stability."

lessons.quote: what problem they're trying to solve
lessons.quoteTr: what problem they're trying to solve
lessons.title: Ask for goal and problem separately
lessons.does: It says what you want to achieve and what's blocking you, so you see which half it got wrong.
lessons.why: The goal is where you want to go and the problem is what's in the way; asking both shows where the gap is.
lessons.try: Ask for both: "Tell me what I'm trying to get done, and what's stopping me right now."

blocks: Restate in your own words what you think the user's goals are and what problem they're trying to solve.
